sq ft campus at 6311 Tradepoint Ave: an appliance facility, a flatbed
delivery center (the FDC)**, and an online-fulfillment building, creating ~500
jobs. Roster idx 2 is specifically the FDC.

I identified the FDC as the long (~520 m), narrow, NE-SW-oriented warehouse
centered at ≈39.2225, -76.4842, distinguished by:
- A large rooftop solar PV array covering roughly half the roof.
- An open-air bulk-material yard along its NW side — rows of stacked

fieldNotes.location: Resolved with medium-high confidence. Roster geocode moved 1439 m within the Tradepoint Atlantic megasite; the FDC building is the long (~520 m) NE-SW oriented warehouse at ~39.2225,-76.4842 with a roof half-covered in a large solar PV array. Identified by: (a) HD press confirms a 3-building, 1.5M sq ft HD campus at 6311 Tradepoint Ave including a flatbed delivery center; (b) the building's distinctive bulk-material yard — rows of stacked lumber/blocks/pallets in open air along its NW side — matches an FDC handling oversized building materials. The two larger plain-roofed warehouses to the NE/SE are the HD appliance and online-fulfillment buildings or other Tradepoint tenants (Amazon, Under Armour also occupy this park).

fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~70 estimate across both long faces; high-resolution count obscured by the solar array shading and trailer clutter — listed uncertain.
